logp.method_description: Partition coefficients (LogP) for each complex were determined using the shake-flask method. A complex was dissolved in equal parts octanol and water or PBS, shaken for 30 min, and left to equilibrate for 24 h during which the aqueous and octanol phases separated. The distribution between phases was determined by measuring the absorbance at 460 nm in each phase. LogP values were calculated as the decadic logarithm of the ratio of solute concentrations in both phases.
